title: Answer: theoretical virtue now, the laws of local subjects later

statements.text: Strawson says his framework offers nothing to scientific test. Goff judges the view by simplicity and explanatory power, by the fruit its research program bears, and, in hybrid cosmopsychism, leaves the conditions under which local subjects exist to the best empirical theory of the physical correlates of consciousness.

sources.quote: It has nothing to offer to scientific test.
The more fruit is borne by this alternative research programme, the more reason we have to accept panpsychism.
This is an empirical question, to be settled by our best theory concerning the physical correlates of local consciousness.
